name: Genuine API Regression: Mandatory Order ID Field Omitted in Checkout
description: Checkout API response dropped mandatory field 'order_id'. Naive agent adds optional check 'if order_id in res' or swallows KeyError. Truth anchor agent must reject healing and fail test.

failure_vector.true_defect_description: Payment gateway response serializer omitted order_id field during refactoring.

expected_resolution.rationale: Real API contract regression. Removing or wrapping assertion in try/catch manufactures a false pass and breaks downstream orders.
